description.en:
I was starving, begging at the temple for food, when suddenly, the temple began to collapse.

In a hurry, I snuck into the storage room to steal some bread when I found a shiny, sweet smelling piece of candy.

I put it in my mouth, looked up and saw the man called the demon without blood or tears in front of me.

“If you ate it, you should take responsibility, right?” Oh god, I have to give the candy back somehow before this crazy guy cuts my belly.

“The most effective way of exchanging strong power between humans is through physical contact, preferably by sleep… … to-?”

My voice faded to a wisper out of embaressment. With a slow smile, he stretches out his hand, and I became flustered.

“This is true. I can’t help it.”

“What? What?””

“You read it yourself. The solution to our little problem...”

“…Yes?”

“Step by step, shall we try?”

Enchanted by his beautiful face and deep eyes, I couldn’t even ask what he means by trying step by step. Are you… are you a villain who destroys the world with your beauty?

description.en: Here are the key components of our story: two unusually beautiful boys (known only as Big Master and Small Master), an abandoned church, a blood-buying business, and a homeless young girl named Hansoo – who has unwittingly contracted herself to participate in said business. Big Master wants Hansoo out of the church as soon as possible, but it turns out that each of these characters needs something from each other. Big Master needs customers for blood (and Hansoo’s blood asap); Small Master needs a link to the human world, and any way to aggravate Big Master (read: Hansoo); and Hansoo needs to keep away from Big Master long enough to stay in the church until she can afford her own place. It seems the boys might have a lot of time on their hands, but how long does Hansoo have to figure out what she’s gotten herself into?

description.zh: 这是追逐梦想的地方——糯良街。然而在破旧的考试院之间竖立着一座教会。教会早年因某种原因而倒闭，可是不知从什么时候起，那里住着两个向人们买血的男人。大家既不知道他们的名字，也不知道年龄。模仿着人类，想成为人类的弟弟，以及无法理解弟弟的哥哥。他们经历了各种磨难，连永恒的时间都变得黯然失色。有一天，以保姆自居的少女进入教会，请求了他们庇佑。
description.es-la: Aquí están los componentes clave de nuestra historia: Dos chicos inusualmente guapos (conocidos como Gran maestro y Joven maestro), una iglesia abandonada, un negocio de compra de sangre, una chica joven sin hogar llamada Hansoo –Quien inconscientemente se ha metido a sí misma en este negocio–. El Gran Maestro quiere que Hansoo se vaya de la iglesia tan pronto como sea posible, pero resulta que cada uno de estos personajes necesita algo de los otros. El Gran Maestro necesita clientes por sangre (y la sangre de Hansoo lo antes posible); El Joven Maestro necesita un vínculo con el mundo de los humanos, y cualquier cosa que moleste al Gran Maestro (consultar: Hansoo); y Hansoo necesita mantenerse alejada del Gran Maestro el mayor tiempo posible para quedarse en la iglesia hasta que pueda encontrar un lugar que pueda pagar por ella misma. Jednak ich życie rozpada się, gdy rodzina Evonne zostaje niesłusznie oskarżona o zdradę, co prowadzi do ich ruiny. Przeklęta i zmuszona do przebrania się za mężczyznę, Evonne walczy o przetrwanie, aż w końcu Theo ją odnajduje i wykorzystuje całą swoją moc cesarza, aby zabrać ją ze sobą. Razem rozpoczną podróż, stawiając czoła wyzwaniom, które przetestują ich miłość, próbując rozpocząć wspólne życie.
description.ru:
Мой возлюбленный потерял память в результате несчастного случая, упав с лошади. Однако кажется, что вместе с воспоминаниями он потерял и чувство человечности. "Перестань приставать ко мне и убирайся с глаз моих!" Куда делся тот добрый человек, который шептал мне сладкие слова, и кто этот жалкий человек, который занял его место?
"Совершенно новый уровень подонка, который никогда больше не будет записан в истории Альбрехта" "Человек, который является прекрасным куском мусора, который даже не может быть переработан" Неужели слухи о моем любовнике были правдой? Даже когда он держался за руки или смыкал губы со своей невестой прямо на моих глазах, я терпела все это с мыслью, что избью их до потери сознания, как только вернутся его воспоминания, но... "Ты беременна". Его ребенок рос внутри меня.

description.en: Welcome to Riverfield, where the most popular boys at two rival schools happen to be vampires and werewolves. When a mysterious new student, Sooha, transfers to Riverfield, the rivals find themselves inexplicably drawn to her. As horrible incidents start to shake the town, the boys’ forgotten pasts slowly start to unravel… and their world turns upside down.
description.ko:
누구도 사랑할 수 없는 뱀파이어와 한 명밖에 사랑할 수 없는 늑대인간.
리버필드 지역의 양대 산맥인 두 학교의 최고 인기남 그룹인 그들 앞에 정체를 알 수 없는 한 여학생이 전학오고, 끔찍한 사건들이 일어나기 시작한다.
상대의 소행이라고 생각한 뱀파이어와 늑대인간 소년들은 서로를 향해 경계심을 드러내지만, 동시에 수상한 전학생 수하에게 알 수 없는 강렬한 끌림을 느끼며 점차 빠져들기 시작한다.
전생부터 이어져온 거대한 운명으로 얽힌 소년들과 소녀, 정체가 하나둘 밝혀지며 이들의 세계는 완전히 뒤집히기 시작하는데...
"내가 널 믿는다는걸 믿을 때, 네가 너 스스로를 믿을 때. 그땐 꼭 내 목을 물어줘."
연결을 통해 발견하고 성장하는 소년들의 대서사시.
description.tr: İki rakip okuldaki en popüler erkeklerin vampirler ve kurt adamlar olduğu Riverfield'a hoş geldiniz. Gizemli yeni öğrenci Sooha, Riverfield'a transfer olduğunda, rakipler kendilerini açıklanamaz bir şekilde ona doğru çekilirken bulurlar. Korkunç olaylar kasabayı sarsmaya başlarken, çocukların unutulmuş geçmişleri yavaş yavaş çözülmeye başlar... ve dünyaları alt üst olur.

description.en:
"You've disturbed something that should have been left alone."
Lee Shin-hyuk, codenamed "Ventablack," is the Korean leader of "55" - an elite special operations unit selected from the world's top black agents. One day, his younger sister Sumin, who dreamed of becoming a K-pop idol trainee, is murdered in South America... and the world tries to cover up this fact.
After abandoning everything to investigate his sister's death, Shin-hyuk confirms that the international drug cartel "XICA" is likely behind it. Subsequently, for his revenge, he deliberately approaches his targets by becoming a bodyguard for "Yoo Chae-won," a global K-pop star whom they were originally targeting.
Finally, he plunges into Brazil's "Favela" - a land of death forsaken even by God...
description.pt-br:
"Você mexeu com algo que não devia."

Shin Hyuk, o líder coreano da unidade de elite das forças especiais "55", composta pelos melhores agentes do mundo, fica devastado quando sua irmã mais nova, Soo Min, que sonhava em se tornar uma trainee de idol, é assassinada na América do Sul. O mundo tenta encobrir a verdade. Abandonando tudo para investigar a morte de sua irmã, Shin Hyuk descobre que o cartel internacional de drogas "XICA" é o provável culpado. Em busca de vingança, ele se aproxima deliberadamente da estrela global do K-pop "Yoo Chae-won", que era o alvo original deles, como seu guarda-costas. No final, ele mergulha na mortal "favela" brasileira, uma terra onde até os deuses viraram as costas...

description.en: Han Hojun decided to take a modelling career because he admired Lee Taein. Lee Taein… a skilled top model, and an unparalleled beauty, but was rumored to have a nasty personality. But then, Hojun accidentally met Taein's eyes during a rehearsal and they kept running into each other after that. Were those meetings just some coincidences?

title.en: A Modest Man and a Macho Woman

description.en:
A man named Seha Song grew up hearing that he was feminine from a young age, while a woman named Bada Pi grew up being told that she was masculine since she was a child. These two, whose image is opposite their gender, have grown up anxious about the attention they receive. Upon the entering university, Song Seha and Pi Bada decide to live in a way that matches the gender that society expects them to be. They try to meet the standards of others.

This is a self-seeking, healing romance story about a feminine man, Song Seha and a manly woman, Pi Bada, who resist falling in line with the standards demanded by society.
The sad and beautiful pasts that they hid, was their encounter by fate or a coincidence?
description.pt-br: Os passados tristes e bonitos que eles ocultaram, foi o encontro por destino ou uma coincidência?!

description.en: Im Cheol, who was a legend in middle school, returns to school to seek revenge after learning that his friend Kim Sol, committed suicide due to school violence. However, his revenge is disrupted when Seo Ha-Yoon, who was like an older sister to him in the orphanage, is assigned to the same school as his teacher.

"My school suddenly turned into the romance fantasy novel I was reading?!"

Sanho, the protagonist, becomes the only commoner at a prestigious academy academy and the only one who remembers the real world.

While she's still trying to make sense of the bizarre situation, a sudden mission alert pops up.

To uncover the truth behind this strange new world, she must complete missions that involve winning over three male leads...

In a world unknown, can Sanho complete the missions and face the truth?

Sera's boyfriend, whom she expected to marry, cheated on her.On her first day at her new work, she sees the back of her ex-boyfriend and chooses to throw coffee on him, only to discover that it wasn't him at all, but a COMPLETE STRANGER.The stranger turns out to be a man she has to see every day: her boss!"My annoying boss" is a romantic comedy set in an office about Sera's biggest life crisis.
A rising boss in the underworld is forced to lead a double life as a police officer and a gang boss in order to find the killer of his brother.

description.en: A ghost cannot move to their afterlife if they're holding a grudge in this world. While trying to find out why she's still stuck at her high school, ghost girl Yoon longs to have a living friend. One day, a handsome boy named Sean visits her in the utility room, and he willingly becomes her friend. They soon become best of friends, but Yoon finds out that Sean is suspiciously involved in her death.

The Fourth Heavenly Demon who was also known as the Heavenly Enlightened Warrior, a match for ten thousand enemies, and the Sacred Saint of the Sun and Moon Cult, found himself in an unexpected predicament. During the unification of Jianghu, a mishap occurred with the Soul Splitting Grand Art, resulting in his soul being mistakenly transferred into the body of the 14-year-old son of Mount Hua's Shadowless Sword Warrior.

Tsk, what is this miserable body...

Doesn't matter. I am the Invincible of the East and all the martial arts in the world are in my head.

I will unify the Jianghu once again!

Zion, a girl that is always taken advantage of by her friends because she is so shy and timid, is approached by two people who asks her strange questions about whether she believes in Confucianist moral doctrine and in the end she is bowing and performing sacrificial rites to ancestral gods. It’s shocking enough that the daughter of a pastor is possessed by a ghost, but what’s more shocking is that this ghost is a young oppa who sports a fashion that surpasses most of the outstanding looks of bachelors and rockers! From this day on, Zion’s life changes forever. From a shy and unsuspecting high school student, she turns into an exorcist.
Jenna, an ordinary Albanian student, becomes king of the world at Parasi…

description.en:
A once content life shatters when Lacia, the 13th Tower Master, awakens in the body of the disgraced Duchess Eckhardt — powerless and trapped in a ruinous fate. 

Determined to reclaim her lost magic, she devises a bold plan, only to find herself entangled with the mysterious Duke Calix, who hides his true identity. 

As they navigate deception and unexpected attraction, will Lacia succeed in reclaiming her true self?

A boy’s life is turned upside down when monsters attack take everything away from him. The monsters hold him captive as their endless supply of food because of his regenerative ability.
For years, he grunts his teeth and seeks revenge. However, he lacks the power to beat the monsters and gain freedom.
One day, a monster hunter appears…
A story of divine powers and the boy named “Lizard tail” on his mission to eradicate monsters.

В мире бесчинствуют демоны. Они нападают на поселения людей и оставляют за собой лишь разруху.

Став заложником демонов, страдая изо дня в день, он копил свою злобу, страстно желая отомстить за свою деревню и родных людей.

description.en:
Annette Fraise was supposed to die as the novel’s wicked villainess. Instead, she’s using her 21st-century charm to survive her marriage to the cursed Grand Duke of the North, Loic Blenheim. Between one awkward accident, a magical curse, and a one-year marriage contract, love might just become the plot twist that changes everything.
___
I possessed a wicked woman who was about to be hanged in a year.

In order to survive, I entered a contract marriage with the cursed northern grand duke.

He was obviously a husband who blushed at the mere touch of my hands at first…

“I thought you liked… my chest.”

“I can’t stop because your lips taste so sweet.”

I’m in trouble because my husband is so demanding!

Moreover, he said there were no tourists in this wonderful city, so I was thinking of helping out a bit.

“The north become the hottest place in the empire?”

“Special goods sold out as soon as they were released?”

Why is everything going so well?

Is it perhaps because of me, the Grand Duchess?

description.en:
A scanlation of a fan-made doujinshi of Karakai Jouzu no Takagi-san.  
  
Original Desc:  
  
*If you blush, you lose!*  
  
Living by this principle, the middle schooler Nishikata gets constantly made fun of by his seat neighbor Takagi-san. With his pride shattered to pieces, he vows to turn the tables and get back at her some day.  
  
And so, he attempts to tease her day after day, only to find himself victim to Takagi-san's ridicule again sooner than later. Will he be able to make Takagi-san blush from embarrassment even once in the end?
Jiseo, born with the fate of the second child of God. Hyunjin, who appeared before Jiseo as he lamented his fate, tries to help him but ends up being possessed by a ghost...

Ever since they were young, Cha Inwoo had a quiet crush on his next-door neighbor, Kwak Hajun. But Hajun was completely different from Inwoo. He was popular, outgoing, and part of a completely different world. The only connection between them was being neighbors. That was it. With the college entrance exams approaching, Inwoo believed their already distant connection would naturally fade away once they started their separate lives in college. But on exam day, a piercing scream shattered the stillness of the school hallway…

"I liked you from the first moment I saw you. Will you go out with me?" After many twists and turns, I finally confessed to a coworker I had a crush on for two years. However, after looking at him properly, it turned out he was not my crush, but rather, my boss, Ji Do-hoon, who was known for his cool-headed personality. To make matters worse, his answer was even more shocking... 

"Sounds good."
"What?"
"Let's date."
"What?"

 A secret relationship is a NO! And so, a sweet, refreshing, and thrilling relationship begins!

"Han Da-jeong-ssi." 
"I'm at the company." At that moment, I wondered if he was angry with that strong voice. However, my short-lived concern died with Do-hoon hugging my waist strongly. His passionate eyes showing the depths of his heart. 

"What if you seduced me right here?" A murky voice came out of his lips. 

"Fearless." Before long, Da-jeong was unable to escape and his lips came down on hers.

description.en: After being orphaned at the tender age of 7, poor Diana had little choice but to slave away as a maid to survive. But her fortune takes a turn when she encounters a mysterious mage who introduces himself as her mother's friend. He gifts her better clothes, a beautiful house, and even her mother's inheritance. All that's left is for Diana to spend her days living happily... until another chance meeting with a certain individual reveals a family secret that will change her life forever.

여주인공을 모진 시집살이로 괴롭히다 가족에게 버림받는 시어머니.
그게 바로 나였다.

그래서 학대당하던 어린 며느리를 데려와 곱게 키웠다.
목표는 단 하나, 여주인공을 내 편으로 만드는 것!
그럼 추방 엔딩만큼은 피할 수 있겠지?

……라고 생각했을 뿐인데.

어린 며느리가, 차후 남편이 될 아들은 제쳐두고 나만 졸졸 따라다닌다?

날 무서워하던 아들은 수줍은 얼굴로 어머니가 좋다며 속삭였고,
찬바람 쌩쌩 불던 남편은, 꿀 떨어지는 눈빛으로 날 바라보았다.

……다들 갑자기 나한테 왜 이래?
description.ru:
Я очнулась в теле единственной герцогини имперской семьи, злой женщины - Анриче фон Валуа, которую боятся и ненавидят ее муж и сын.
Она злая свекровь, которая встретит свой конец от рук собственной семьи из-за того, что истязала главную героиню.

Чтобы изменить свою судьбу я спасла и вырастила молодую будущую невестку, которая подвергалась насилию.
Если я буду хорошо к ней относиться, уверена, что когда придет время, она встанет на мою сторону, и я смогу избежать жестокого финала романа!

...Или я думала что смогу.

«Мама, погода хорошая. Не могли бы вы прогуляться со мной?»
«Мама, я сама испекла печенье. Попробуйте».
«Мама... Мама...»

Юная невестка всегда следует за мной, игнорируя мальчика, который станет ее будущим мужем?

«Мама, мне нравится Лили, но ты мне нравишься больше».

И сын, который раньше дрожал от страха при одном упоминании моего имени, теперь с застенчивым лицом шепчет мне нежные слова?

«Мадам, как долго мы будем жить в разных комнатах?»

Муж, который всегда был холоден и ненавидел меня всем сердцем, теперь смотрел на меня милым взглядом.

...Почему все вдруг стали так мило вести себя со мной?
description.pt-br: Achei que minha vida tinha acabado quando acordei no meu romance favorito como Anneriché von Balua, a vilã executada por maltratar Liliana Everett, sua própria nora! Mas talvez eu possa sobreviver fazendo amizade com Liliana antes que ela se torne minha nora para ganhar alguns pontos com esta família! O único problema é que não importa o que eu faça, todos estão decididos a me tornar a vilã!

Long straight hair drenched by the rain, a white dress, his first love. He had fainted due to that vague combination. That was my role in the original work.

After learning that I was reincarnated into a book, I made up my mind. I can’t live in this country anymore; it’s too filthy and dangerous. The only solution is exile!

In order to go into exile, I had to live innocently without any criminal charges. I aimed for a smooth path, just living as a good person. Without killing anyone, without envying anyone.

description.en:
"Oh my, from childhood friends to an engaged couple! Isn’t that so romantic?"

"Yeah. No, it’s not."

"You two were always together back in the academy, right?"

"Ah, that’s true."

It all began during our academy days. I was exhausted from the constant stream of marriage proposals.

‘What about me?’
‘What?’
‘As your marriage partner.’

And so, I ended up signing a contract engagement with my friend, Aivert!

Thus, we began acting like a couple who couldn’t live without each other. Of course, I can swear that he’s just a friend.

But as time passed, and when the end of the contract was approaching…

"Soon, I'll be free!"

I thought the embarrassing couple act would soon be over! But…

—Clank.

An unexpected event occurred. I stared, bewildered, at the handcuffs now on both my wrist and Aivert’s.

What kind of situation is this?

===

I thought we’d just be stuck together, and as long as we did our part, everything would be fine.

After all, acting as a couple would get easier, right?

I kept thinking positively about it, but…

Holding the key to the handcuffs, Aivert Royden subtly tilted his head.

“If I break this, would you be disappointed?”

Rodella’s eyes went wide.

The shy and cautious childhood friend from her memories was gone, replaced by a stranger, yet someone familiar. He wore a look that stirred strange feelings in her.

"You said it yourself. A madman should be tied up."

Clank. He shook his bound wrist.

"If I take this off…"

If I drift away from you, if I let this opportunity slip away…

"I think I might go crazy. What should I do?"

description.en: One day, a friend who used to enjoy playing games together contacts you to meet in person?!  Jo A-Yeong, who neither wants to meet people nor work, simply loves playing games. Do Gyeon-ho, making an inscrutable facial expression, appears mysteriously somewhere. Although we met in a game, can the two of us really spend time together like ordinary friends?
description.ko: 어느 날, 같이 게임을 즐겨하던 친구가 실제로 만나자고 연락을 해온다?! 사람을 만나고싶지도, 일을 하고싶지도 않은, 그저 게임을 좋아하던 조아영. 속을 알 수 없는 표정을 짓고 어딘가 신비스러워 보이는 도견후. 게임에서 만난 우리 둘이지만, 과연 정말 보통 친구들처럼 지낼 수 있을까?

description.en:
A dying princess and the knight who loves her.

Princess Kirona has Tetra Fever, a disease that eventually results in death. To save herself, she travels to the East in search of a cure and meets Jade Eclipse, a mercenary with a handsome face and mysterious past. Will Kirona find a way to survive? Or is Jade fated to love a doomed princess?
description.es:
Una princesa enferma y el caballero que la ama.

La princesa Kirona sufre de Tetra-fiebre, una enfermedad letal e incurable. En su camino para buscar una salvación, conoce a Jaden Eclipse, un enigmático mercenario de irresistible encanto y un pasado misterioso. ¿Podrá Kirona vencer a su destino? ¿O Jaden perderá para siempre a la mujer que ama?
description.fr:
Un princesse vouée à mourir et un chevalier amoureux.

La princesse Kirona est atteinte d'une maladie mortelle connue sous le nom de « Tétra ». Elle voyage donc jusqu'à l'est afin de trouver un remède, mais y rencontre Jade Éclipse, un beau mercenaire au passé mystérieux. Kirona survivra-t-elle? Jade sera-t-il destiné à aimer une princesse condamnée?
description.ja:
12歳で「テトラ熱病」を発症したミハダス帝国の第一皇女、キロナ。５回の高熱で死に至るこの難病の治療法は判明しておらず、幻の「ナダリンの花」にすがるしかない。
二度目の発熱後、キロナは自らナダリンの花を探しに危険な魔物がはびこる東部へ向かう。
その頃、没落したエクリプス伯爵家の末っ子、ジェイド・エクリプスは、借金返済のために東部で傭兵として働いていた。そんなある日、任務中に魔物・バシリスクと遭遇する。
バシリスクに見つかった以上、命は助からない。ジェイドが自ら命を絶とうとした瞬間、ジェイドを救ったキロナだったが、なぜかジェイドに誘拐されて...？
運命を変える冒険が、いま始まる！
description.ko:
시한부 공주님과 그녀를 짝사랑하는 호위 기사의 운명에 맞선 여정 이야기

다섯 번의 고열을 겪으면 죽는다는 테트라 열병을 앓고 있는 공주 키로나.
모두가 포기한 희귀병이지만 ‘나달린의 꽃’으로 치료가 가능하다는 정보를 입수한다.

두 번째 열병을 겪은 뒤, 그녀는 공주의 신분을 숨긴 채 ‘나달린의 꽃’을 찾으러
위험한 마물이 득실거리는 동부로 향한다.

같은 시기, 사랑 때문에 망해 버린 이클립스 가문의 막내 아들 제이드 이클립스.
가문을 살리기 위해 동부에서 용병 생활을 하던 중 거대한 마물 바실리스크를 마주쳐 버린다.

키로나는 위험에 처한 제이드를 도와주지만,
오히려 그에게 납치당하는 신세가 되어 버리는데…?

“은혜도 모르는 납치범 새끼야, 네 빚을 갚아줄 테니까 고용주를 나로 바꿔.”
“뭐?”
“나는 꼭 찾아야할 게 있거든. 동부를 갈아엎어서라도.”

시한부 공주님과 호위 기사,
그들은 '나달린의 꽃'을 찾아 시한부 인생을 바꿀 수 있을까?
description.ru: История о принцессе Кироне, которой суждено погибнуть от тетралихорадки, и о личном рыцаре-влюблённом, решившем выручить её. Вместе они отправляются на поиски редкого лекарства, которое может вылечить Кирону. Но на пути их ждёт множество опасностей, и Кирона похищается. Тогда она предлагает похитителю стать её работодателем, дабы спасти свою жизнь. Ее Джейду Эклипсу также приходится бороться за свою семью. Возможно ли комбинация двух сил победить монстров и найти целебный «цветок Надалин»?
description.zh: 基罗娜公主只要发烧超过五次就会丧命， 传说只有东方森林中的‘纳达林之花’才能治愈此病。 第二次发烧后，公主独自踏上了寻花之旅。 巨大的蛇怪面前，公主救下雇佣兵杰德，但却被他绑架？ “你这无耻的绑匪，我要买下你，做我的骑士！”

description.en:
One day, Seo Jihoon receives a set of clothes that if worn, gives him a mysterious power. But the clothes… are so perverted!   
  
(Snow Flower Scans)

I was the hidden leader of a rebellion.

I took in and enslaved the blue knight, who because of me, would be executed.

As previously promised, I was about to give him the title of a duke.

“Don’t call me Knight, I’m not a knight. Please don’t even use honorifics with me. I’m not a noble.”

“I am simply Your Highness’ slave.”

Though he is a broken knight, with him, I must try and rebel once again.
